subject: LEAP-SECOND directive
notes: { ON | OFF } with ON un-underlined in the printed format, so per 5.2.3 a bare >>LEAP-SECOND selects ON - the 'specified or implied' case 7.3.17.4 GR2/GR4 presuppose. Any other operand is COBOL1911. The 7.3.17.3 SR1 PLACEMENT rule is a different row and stays with the stage as COBOL1650.
